_doc: Shared glyph map. tools/gen_assets.py makes the textures and font JSONs from it; tools/build_datapack.py builds the HUD text from it. Codepoints are hex strings.

hearts._doc: 9x9 heart icons drawn over the second health row (the extra hearts each Chaos Heart gives). One font per vanilla row spacing; same chars in each. Code = base + (index-1)*8 + state.

abilities._doc: 16x16 ability icons above the hotbar, centre of screen. Code = base + (index-1)*4 + (slot-1).

ability_extra._cd: cd_k darkens the top k/8 of an icon (k=8 fully dark). Textures chaoshearts:gui/hud/<name>.png

digits._doc: 3x5 white digits shown on the bottom right of a cooling icon.

meter._doc: 74x4 white bar under the icons, tinted by text colour. Code = base + fill (0..20).

overlays._doc: Full screen overlays shown as a title. Tinted by text colour, so draw them in their own colours (white = tintable).
